evaluation.benchmark: MOT17 pedestrian with distractor/zero-mark preprocessing, CLEAR IoU .5, Identity and HOTA
evaluation.coordinates: uniform integer video-to-original-GT scale verified per sequence, then x/y shifted +1 for one-based MOT output
evaluation.scenario_diagnostics: Separate full-frame Hungarian IoU .5 endpoint/instance diagnostics; not official scenario MOT metrics

scenario_rules.long_low_visibility: visibility <=.3 for >=1s, >=.6 visibility anchors within 1s before and after
scenario_rules.overlap_order_exchange: GT box IoU >=.1, overlap index gaps merged <=ceil(.5*fps) frame steps, horizontal center order flips across >=.6 visibility anchors within 1s
scenario_rules.endpoints: last matched pre / first matched post eligible anchor; denominator reports missing endpoints separately

evaluation.timing: Three fresh tracker runs by default; rotated method order, first update included, no warmup exclusion. Detector/decode/startup excluded from update latency. Descriptive single-host timing, not real-time acceptance.
evaluation.buffer_units: lost_track_buffer is 30-FPS reference frames: 30=1s, 90=3s; backend scales to source FPS

sequences.name: MOT17-09-DPM
sequences.source_description: Low-angle pedestrian street scene; fixed viewpoint visually checked

sequences.name: MOT17-10-DPM
sequences.source_description: Pedestrian scene filmed at night by a moving camera

limitations: Selected compressed training clips, not original benchmark JPEGs or a held-out leaderboard result.
Visibility/order proxies do not establish physical occlusion or true 3D crossing; audit examples separately.
Fixed five-profile sensitivity study; no ReID or CMC ablation, exploratory validation rather than a held-out leaderboard or default-selection gate.
No real-camera, calibrated 3D, Windows, endurance or end-to-end throughput acceptance.
public_scope: Aggregates, source/configuration identifiers and hashes only. Media, GT, event identities/windows, per-frame predictions, weights and paths stay local.
execution_notes: A preliminary incomplete run was discarded after visual audit corrected sequence 09 to fixed viewpoint. The complete 60-run record uses corrected annotations and unchanged frozen parameter profiles.
Timing and predictions come from direct backend calls; no application/worker default or IPC tuning.

visual_spot_check.selection: Longest low-visibility and first GT-ID-sorted crossing event per sequence
visual_spot_check.scope: Assisted spot-check, not exhaustive independent annotation; raw imagery remains local

targeted_parameter_outcomes.selection: One ByteTrack longer-buffer gain and one BoT-SORT lower-gates regression; default/candidate before/event/after
targeted_parameter_outcomes.finding: Annotated subject visibility loss and endpoint-state changes supported; not proof of uninterrupted identity correctness

python_pytest.scope: Application/release contracts; 4 real-model tests and 2 isolated-library contracts opt-in

isolated_real_library_parameter_contract.scope: Includes two real-backend confidence-floor, 45-frame gap and 14-FPS time-budget tests; no real-video accuracy claim
